story.titleZh: 安东内利再次越界，将被罚5秒
story.summaryZh: 安东内利在新加坡大奖赛中再次越界，将被处以5秒时间罚分。幸运的是，他比皮亚斯特里领先25秒，但这将影响他超越诺里斯的机会。

story.summaryEn: Antonelli exceeds track limits again - that's going to be a five-second time penalty. Fortunately he's 25s ahead of Piastri, but that will hurt his chances of passing and pulling clear of Norris #F1 #SingaporeGP
detailZh: 安东内利在新加坡大奖赛中再次越界 - 那将是一个五秒的时间罚分。幸运的是，他比皮亚斯特里领先25秒，但这将影响他超越诺里斯的机会。

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利踏上美墨巴赛事之旅，有望成为史上最年轻F1世界冠军
relatedItems.summaryZh: 安东内利即将在美国、墨西哥和巴西的赛事中挑战成为史上最年轻F1世界冠军，他如何保持谦逊？通过赛前洗车。
relatedItems.originalTitle: When Kimi Antonelli left home for this next run of races in the US, Mexico and Brazil, it was highly likely he’d next return as the youngest F1 world...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
When Kimi Antonelli left home for this next run of races in the US, Mexico and Brazil, it was highly likely he’d next return as the youngest F1 world champion in history
So how does he stay grounded? By washing his car before leaving: https://racer.com/2026/10/19/how-antonelli-handles-standing-on-the-verge-of-f1-history #F1
detailZh:
当安东内利离开家前往美国、墨西哥和巴西的下一轮赛事时，他很可能将成为历史上最年轻的F1世界冠军。
那么他是如何保持谦逊的呢？通过在离开前洗车：https://racer.com/2026/10/19/how-安东内利-handles-standing-on-the-verge-of-f1-history #F1
detailEn:
When Kimi Antonelli left home for this next run of races in the US, Mexico and Brazil, it was highly likely he’d next return as the youngest F1 world champion in history
So how does he stay grounded? By washing his car before leaving: https://racer.com/2026/10/19/how-antonelli-handles-standing-on-the-verge-of-f1-history #F1

relatedItems.titleZh: 非洲大奖赛将于2030年代初加入F1赛历
relatedItems.summaryZh: 非洲大奖赛将于2030年代初加入F1赛历，将在卢旺达新建的赛道举办，这是自1993年以来非洲大陆的首个F1赛事。

media.altZh: 非洲大奖赛将于2030年代初加入F1赛历 · 第 1 张

relatedItems.originalTitle: The African Grand Prix is coming to the F1 calendar in the early 2030s, with a 10-year deal agreed to host a race at a new purpose-built circuit in Rw...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
The African Grand Prix is coming to the F1 calendar in the early 2030s, with a 10-year deal agreed to host a race at a new purpose-built circuit in Rwanda
It is set to be the first race on the African continent since 1993 #F1
detailZh:
非洲大奖赛将在2030年代初加入F1赛历，与主办方达成了一份为期10年的协议，将在卢旺达新建的赛道举办比赛
这将是自1993年以来非洲大陆上的第一场F1比赛 #F1
detailEn:
The African Grand Prix is coming to the F1 calendar in the early 2030s, with a 10-year deal agreed to host a race at a new purpose-built circuit in Rwanda
It is set to be the first race on the African continent since 1993 #F1
